entities.name: Senka
entities.description: Guildless rogue of Ravnica called the Stealer of Serets, on an Azorius most-wanted list.

entities.name: Dinrova Horror
entities.description: Monster Senka released that devoured Dimir guards.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: Guild that put Senka on its most-wanted list.

entities.name: Orzhov
entities.description: Guild whose armored transport was consumed by the horror.

events.summary: Senka evades Dimir safeguards and breaks into the Dinrova Building.
events.quote: Senka somehow managed to evade Dimir detection spells and traps and broke into the Dinrova Building .

events.summary: Senka releases a Dinrova Horror, which devours the Dimir guards and consumes an Orzhov transport.
events.quote: The horror devoured the Dimir guards, escaped the building, and consumed a passing Orzhov Armored Transport.

events.summary: The Azorius learn Senka's name and add her to their most wanted list.
events.quote: only once they had learned her name did they put her on their most wanted list.

relations.quote: At one point she was on an Azorius list of the ten most wanted criminals.
Senka somehow managed to evade Dimir detection spells and traps
